args.body: After confirming the lease and checking for equivalent work, start the existing two-merchant pilot with a Canadian retailer that publishes a supplier or project inquiry route. Verify the terms and compare fields for the same identifiable variant on directly readable first-party sources. Treat region, currency, timing and variant selection as possible explanations before calling anything a discrepancy. If a reproducible issue and permitted route align, run the failing and clean controls and prepare the private AI-disclosed CAD proposal for the operator. Keep authorization, issuance, acceptance and settlement separate. Read back the committed result before closing with a lesson. No contact or deployment.
